відповідь.body: {"content":[{"type":"text","text":"{\"version\":\"1\",\"text\":\"I have built this ensemble around your wish to keep your skirt, pairing it with a relaxed brown sweater that offers the comfort of casual wear while maintaining a polished silhouette. I chose burgundy dress shoes and a braided red belt to introduce a vibrant splash of color that anchors the neutral top and bottom. To complete the look for your office day, I selected an olive green backpack, which balances the formality of the occasion with practical utility.\",\"how_to_wear\":[\"Start by wearing the braided red belt to cinch the waist of your skirt, which defines your silhouette before adding the sweater.\",\"Layer the relaxed brown sweater over your top as a soft outer layer to add warmth without bulk.\",\"Carry the olive backpack on your shoulder or across your body for ease of movement throughout your workday.\",\"Tuck the front of the sweater slightly into the skirt at the waist to keep the layers connected and avoid looking bulky.\"],\"wrong_photos\":[],\"swap\":{\"item\":\"#482·40\",\"why\":\"belt\",\"to\":\"\"},\"named\":[{\"n\":\"#101·05\",\"what\":\"relaxed brown sweater\"},{\"n\":\"#196·10\",\"what\":\"burgundy dress shoes\"},{\"n\":\"#482·40\",\"what\":\"braided red belt\"},{\"n\":\"#59·40\",\"what\":\"olive green backpack\"}],\"about_items\":[{\"n\":\"#37·42\",\"text\":\"This is your own skirt that you have chosen as the base of your outfit.\"},{\"n\":\"#101·05\",\"text\":\"The sweater is crafted in a soft, relaxed fit with a ribbed crew neck and hem. It features long sleeves with snug ribbed cuffs that provide structure at the wrists, and a comfortable length that sits just at the hip, draping gracefully over your skirt.\"},{\"n\":\"#196·10\",\"text\":\"These burgundy dress shoes are styled with a sleek pointed toe and a low, sturdy heel. The smooth leather finish adds a touch of elegance to your feet, while the classic pump shape ensures you stay comfortable from morning meetings to late afternoon work.\"},{\"n\":\"#482·40\",\"text\":\"The braided belt is made of rich red leather with an intricate woven pattern that catches the light. It features a sturdy silver-tone buckle and a smooth leather tab for fastening, adding a vibrant pop of color to your waistline.\"},{\"n\":\"#59·40\",\"text\":\"This olive green backpack combines durable fabric with black leather handles and trim. It has a spacious main compartment secured by a zipper and a convenient front pocket for quick access to essentials, making it an ideal companion for your office days.\"}]}"}],"usage":{"input_tokens":10360,"output_tokens":561},"stop_reason":"end_turn"}
